categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai International Airport Co., Ltd. primarily operates in civil airport operations, providing ground support services for domestic and international airlines and passengers. Its business includes aviation-related services such as aircraft landing, parking, passenger and cargo services, as well as non-aviation businesses like commercial leasing, retail, catering, advertising, logistics, and property management. The company manages two major airports: Shanghai Pudong International Airport and Shanghai Hongqiao International Airport.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced airport infrastructure and efficient operational support systems to ensure safe and smooth aircraft ground handling. It emphasizes digital transformation, intelligent operation centers, and integrated logistics platforms to enhance operational efficiency. Safety management is supported by modernized governance systems and digital safety monitoring platforms. The company also invests in green technologies and sustainable energy solutions to promote low-carbon airport operations.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include domestic and international airlines, passengers, cargo operators, retail tenants, and logistics service users. The company serves the aviation transportation market, focusing on passenger and cargo throughput. It also caters to commercial tenants within airport premises and logistics clients, including cross-border e-commerce. The primary markets are the aviation and logistics sectors within the Yangtze River Delta region and international air transport routes.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Shanghai, China, managing Shanghai Pudong International Airport and Shanghai Hongqiao International Airport. Its service network extends globally with scheduled flights connecting to 48 countries and 291 passenger and cargo destinations worldwide. The company also has investments and operations in the Yangtze River Delta region and maintains overseas equity investments.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai International Airport operates primarily as a midstream service provider in the aviation supply chain, offering ground handling, passenger services, cargo logistics, and airport facility management. It also engages in downstream commercial activities such as retail and advertising within airport premises. The company holds upstream investments in related logistics and aviation support enterprises.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on building a world-class international aviation hub with emphasis on safety, digitalization, green transformation, and customer-centric service enhancement. Strategic priorities include expanding international and domestic route networks, improving cargo logistics capabilities, advancing intelligent airport operations, and deepening reform and governance modernization. R&D efforts target operational efficiency, safety management digitalization, and sustainable airport development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through aviation-related fees such as landing, parking, passenger service, and security fees, which are government-guided prices. Non-aviation revenue streams include commercial leasing, retail and catering operations, advertising, logistics services, and property management, which are market-regulated. The company also earns income from equity investments and financial asset management.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Shanghai International Airport is positioned as a leading airport operator in China and Asia, competing with other major hubs like Guangzhou Baiyun Airport, Beijing Capital and Daxing Airports, and Hong Kong International Airport. It holds a top ranking in passenger and cargo throughput in China and Asia-Pacific, with a strong focus on international connectivity and hub efficiency. The company is recognized for high service quality and operational excellence.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 12.37 billion in 2024, representing an 11.97% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders reached RMB 1.93 billion, more than doubling compared to the previous year. Total assets stood at RMB 70.05 billion with steady growth. The company maintains strong cash flow generation and continues to invest in infrastructure and technology to support growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shanghai International Airport emphasizes its strategic geographic location as a gateway connecting Asia, Europe, and North America, serving the economically vibrant Yangtze River Delta region. It offers comprehensive, high-quality aviation and non-aviation services supported by advanced infrastructure and intelligent operations. The company differentiates itself through its commitment to safety, digital innovation, green airport initiatives, and superior passenger experience, aiming to be a world-class international aviation hub.
